text: Ko onon yo nodditiiɓe wonnde Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen ko ɓiɓɓe Alla rewɓe, e hara Joomi mon hertinan on -ko onon yo sirkooɓe- worɓe ɓen ka ɓiɓɓe, O waɗani Hoore-Makko Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen ɓiɓɓe rewɓe? Alla Toowii e kon ko wi'oton. Pellet, onon hiɗon wowlude e dow Alla Seniiɗo On konngol hattungol kaanude nokku ka dammbuɗon=askatindon ɓiɗɗo e Makko, aaƴiɗon kadi wonnde no woodani Mo ɓiɓɓe rewɓe ɓen ka tentinnde yeddugol Mo.
